name: Italian
bridgesBlurb: One rule, many words. Italian and English share an enormous Latin vocabulary — read the trick, then build each word yourself before you reveal it.
phoneticsSubtitle: An English-style respelling under the Italian — CAPS is the stressed syllable.

reminders.title: 🍝 Your Italian is hungry
reminders.body: Ho fame! Feed it a few frasi — two minutes, that's all.

reminders.title: 🔥 Non dimenticare!
reminders.body: Your streak is still alive… but only just. Qualche frase oggi? 💪

reminders.title: ☕ Un caffè e un po' d'italiano
reminders.body: Best combo there is. Five sentences, e hai finito! 😎

reminders.title: 🛵 Andiamo!
reminders.body: Two minutes on the Vespa of learning. Sei pronto? 🇮🇹

reminders.title: 🍕 Pizza first? No no.
reminders.body: Earn it — qualche frase ti aspetta. Then you can feast. 😋

reminders.title: 🎭 Allora…
reminders.body: The most Italian word there is, and you've got sentences to do. Dai! ✨

reminders.title: 🏛️ Roma non è stata costruita in un giorno
reminders.body: Rome wasn't built in a day — but it was built every day. Five sentences. 🧱

reminders.title: 🎶 Che bello!
reminders.body: A little Italian sounds good on you. Continua così! 🎵

reminders.title: 🍋 Dolce far niente? Non oggi.
reminders.body: The sweetness of doing nothing can wait five minutes. Cominciamo! 🌊

reminders.title: 🔔 Din don!
reminders.body: That's your Italian bell. Facciamolo insieme! 🐐

reminders.title: 🧠 Merenda per il cervello
reminders.body: A little snack for your brain. Qualche frase e basta! 🥐
